items.title: Los viejos intermediarios del petróleo venezolano siguen bajo la lupa tras la caída de Maduro
items.author: Raylí Luján
items.summary: Aunque la estructura de comercialización ha incorporado nuevos participantes, Transparencia Venezuela advierte que figuras vinculadas a las redes anteriores siguen presentes.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — La captura de Nicolás Maduro no ha despejado las interrogantes sobre quiénes controlan el negocio petrolero venezolano ni sobre el destino de sus ingresos. Aunque la estructura de comercialización ha incorporado nuevos participantes y algunos operadores han salido del sector, Transparencia Venezuela advierte que figuras vinculadas a las redes anteriores siguen presentes. La organización también cuestiona las condiciones en que se están asignando los campos petroleros y la falta de información sobre los beneficiarios finales de las empresas que participan en el sector. Ver más: Exportaciones de petróleo venezolano caen a su nivel más bajo en ocho meses por alza en el precio de fletes Transparencia Venezuela entregó esta semana a la Fiscalía Federal del Distrito Sur de Nueva York un informe que busca aportar elementos a la investigación penal que se sigue contra Maduro y Cilia Flores en esa jurisdicción. El documento reconstruye el papel del exmandatario dentro de una red de corrupción transnacional y sus conexiones con economías ilícitas, a partir de diez años de registros, expedientes judiciales, decisiones administrativas y bases de datos. El informe, titulado Corrupción, captura del Estado y redes transnacionales en Venezuela , reconstruye una estructura de 13.521 actores, 30.467 relaciones y 865 empresas, vinculada a 154 casos de corrupción. Según el análisis de la ONG, Maduro ocupa el primer lugar en intermediación estructural dentro de esa red, un indicador que mide su posición como conexión entre distintos actores. En 96 de los 154 casos documentados desde 2013, Transparencia Venezuela identificó US$36.115 millones comprometidos. Para los otros expedientes, el monto no ha sido determinado o publicado. El informe también registra 110 casos que llegaron a tribunales de 26 países y 651 personas vinculadas a las investigaciones: 413 banqueros, empresarios e intermediarios y 238 funcionarios de organismos públicos y del sistema de justicia. La entrega del expediente busca contribuir a las pesquisas de las autoridades estadounidenses. De Freitas ha explicado que la documentación acumulada por la organización durante años permite reconstruir relaciones entre funcionarios, intermediarios, empresas y estructuras financieras. La directora de Transparencia Venezuela también ha señalado las dificultades que supone investigar estas tramas desde otros países. En su experiencia de colaboración con fiscales y cuerpos policiales extranjeros, uno de los obstáculos ha sido explicar el contexto económico e institucional venezolano. Los mecanismos de control cambiario, las diferencias entre las tasas oficiales y las del mercado y las conversiones de bolívares a dólares forman parte de operaciones que no siempre resultan sencillas de reconstruir desde otros sistemas financieros. A ello se suma la necesidad de entender cómo las decisiones administrativas y los controles estatales facilitaron determinadas transacciones. La dimensión de esas redes también aparece en una investigación anterior de Transparencia Venezuela sobre el circuito de comercialización petrolera entre 2019 y 2025. El estudio From Sanctions Evasion to Money Laundering: The Venezuelan Oil Trading Scheme reconstruyó el 80% de 435 embarques identificados durante 2025. El informe describió mecanismos de intermediación, estructuras empresariales en distintas jurisdicciones y formas de pago que, según la organización, dificultaron seguir el recorrido de los ingresos. También identificó operadores que ya aparecían en negocios petroleros de años anteriores. La continuidad de algunos participantes es una de las alertas que recoge el nuevo mapa de empresas del sector petrolero, con datos al 31 de octubre de 2026. De los 303 bloques petroleros y gasíferos considerados en el análisis, 134 están en manos de empresas privadas y 169 permanecen bajo control de Petróleos de Venezuela (Pdvsa). La organización identifica 63 compañías activas procedentes de 33 países. De ellas, 21 son nuevas en el sector, 11 tienen proyectos en estudio y 15 fueron desplazadas. Entre los nombres que aparecen en esa reorganización está el empresario Alejandro Betancourt López, a quien Transparencia Venezuela identifica como operador en la comercialización de crudo sancionado. Betancourt controla actualmente North American Blue Energy Partner (NABEP), a la que se le asignaron 31 bloques y que reporta una producción de 224.000 barriles diarios. Ver más: Nabep tomará control de Petrocedeño y ampliará su operación petrolera en Venezuela La organización señala que el empresario ha sido objeto de señalamientos relacionados con sobreprecios en la crisis eléctrica, préstamos a Pdvsa y presuntos esquemas de lavado de dinero. De acuerdo con sus registros, mantiene 82 empresas en 21 países. El mapa también recoge otros casos que, a juicio de la ONG, requieren mayor escrutinio. Pacific Coast Energy Co. recibió 12 bloques, aunque Transparencia Venezuela afirma que no ha podido establecer con certeza las capacidades de inversión ni la experiencia reciente de la compañía, así como la identidad de sus beneficiarios finales. También menciona a UCC Oil and Gas, vinculada a licencias en el campo gasífero Loran, y a Primavera Infinita LLC, constituida en 2026 y asignataria del bloque Budare-Elotes. La reorganización también desplazó a nombres vinculados al entorno presidencial, como Carlos Malpica Flores y Ramón Carretero Napolitano en Hainan Breey Energy. La organización registra, además, al menos dos casos de presunta vulneración de derechos de propiedad y unos 15 en los que habrían cambiado las condiciones contractuales sin que se conozcan los procedimientos aplicados. En el comunicado difundido con la presentación del informe, Mercedes De Freitas advirtió que la entrada de nuevos participantes no garantiza por sí sola un cambio en las prácticas del sector. “Que salgan unos operadores y entren otros no limpia el sistema. Si no sabemos quién es el beneficiario final de cada empresa ni bajo qué condiciones recibió los campos, el petróleo sigue siendo un vehículo ideal para legitimar capitales”. La directora de Transparencia Venezuela sostuvo en entrevista con Bloomberg Línea que Pdvsa conserva un papel relevante en el negocio y que todavía no existe información suficiente para seguir el recorrido de los ingresos. Entre los datos que considera necesarios están los volúmenes comercializados, los compradores, los precios, los descuentos aplicados, las condiciones de pago y la administración de los recursos. La preocupación alcanza a los contratos de participación productiva y otros acuerdos con empresas privadas. De Freitas considera que deben publicarse los documentos, los campos asignados y las condiciones negociadas, además de identificarse a los beneficiarios finales de cada compañía. La posibilidad de recuperar los recursos involucrados en las tramas de corrupción representa otro desafío. De Freitas advirtió que no será sencillo devolver a Venezuela la totalidad del dinero desviado, debido a que los fondos suelen fragmentarse, trasladarse entre distintas jurisdicciones y convertirse en activos de diferente naturaleza. Cada país tiene sus propios procedimientos judiciales y mecanismos para congelar, confiscar y devolver esos bienes. Por eso, una investigación o una incautación no se traducen automáticamente en la recuperación de los fondos. Ver más: Machado cuestiona el acuerdo petrolero de Trump, pero apuesta por una alianza de largo plazo con EE.UU. De Freitas también señaló que el país no debería contar con esos recursos como una fuente inmediata para financiar su recuperación económica. Aunque considera necesario continuar las investigaciones y los esfuerzos de cooperación internacional, el rastreo y la restitución de activos pueden prolongarse durante años y no necesariamente permiten recuperar todo el patrimonio comprometido. La organización plantea que Venezuela necesitaría instituciones especializadas para investigar la corrupción y gestionar la recuperación de activos, además de mecanismos independientes que permitan administrar los recursos que eventualmente sean restituidos. La cooperación judicial entre países sería determinante para rastrear los fondos y evitar que queden dispersos en diferentes sistemas financieros. Las dudas sobre la rendición de cuentas también alcanzan la información divulgada por el Gobierno a través de Transparencia Soberana, un portal oficial que fue actualizado el 12 de noviembre por Delcy Rodríguez con un balance de ingresos y egresos correspondiente al período entre enero y noviembre de 2026. Según los datos publicados, los ingresos sumaron US$15.603 millones y los egresos alcanzaron US$14.860 millones. De estos últimos, US$14.710 millones correspondieron a salarios de trabajadores del sector público y pensiones, mientras que US$150,5 millones se destinaron a gastos de funcionamiento del Gobierno. Rodríguez destacó que 99 de cada US$100 desembolsados se dirigieron a esos compromisos laborales sociales. El portal también reportó que US$15.148 millones, equivalentes al 97,1% de los ingresos, provinieron de la venta de petróleo y derivados. Sin embargo, las cifras no permiten conocer con suficiente detalle cómo se distribuyeron los recursos. La propia plataforma señala que su información corresponde al Fondo de Protección Social y al Fondo de Infraestructura Nacional, por lo que no constituye una rendición de cuentas integral de todos los ingresos y gastos del Estado. De Freitas cuestionó precisamente la falta de desagregación. Para la directora de Transparencia Venezuela, no basta con informar cuánto dinero se destinó a salarios y pensiones: es necesario conocer cuántos trabajadores públicos recibieron esos pagos, qué organismos fueron cubiertos, cuántos pensionados están incluidos y qué partidas presupuestarias financiaron los desembolsos. La información también debería permitir distinguir entre salarios y bonificaciones, así como identificar los montos asignados a cada institución. Ese nivel de detalle permitiría contrastar las cifras oficiales con los pagos recibidos por los trabajadores y con las necesidades de servicios públicos como hospitales y centros educativos. Ver más: Altos costos de transporte marítimo reducen demanda de EE.UU. por petróleo venezolano De Freitas planteó, además, que el presupuesto nacional y sus modificaciones deben estar disponibles para consulta pública. De esa manera podría verificarse si los gastos corresponden a las partidas aprobadas y si los cambios presupuestarios siguieron los procedimientos correspondientes. La actualización de Transparencia Soberana coincide con una nueva etapa de supervisión estadounidense sobre los ingresos derivados de la comercialización de recursos venezolanos. Para Transparencia Venezuela, ese mecanismo no sustituye la obligación de las autoridades de explicar cómo se utilizan los fondos ni de publicar información que permita su fiscalización.

Nov 22 : Captain Bruno Fernandes said Manchester United have offered him a new contract but discussions have been put on hold as the club focuses on turning around its poor form.
Fernandes' current deal expires at the end of the season, although United hold an option to extend the midfielder's contract by a further year until June 2028, giving the club more time to reach an agreement on fresh terms.
"Yeah, the club offered me a new contract, so I think that, from their side, shows that they want me to stay. And as you said, there are no negotiations going on," Fernandes told Sky Sports in an interview published on Sunday.
"We spoke about the contract at the end of last season, we came in at the beginning of this season speaking about the contract, but because of the context of the team and the club, I just put that to one side because I don't think it's the right moment, neither for me nor for the club, to be talking about negotiations.

"The most important thing now is that the club gets back to winning games."
The Portugal international also addressed comments claiming he had demanded more money and a longer deal, saying his priority was to remain at Old Trafford and help restore the club's fortunes.
United are third from bottom of the Premier League standings, having won only one of their opening 10 league matches, their worst start to a season in 40 years.
"I've seen people saying that he's asked for more money, he's asked for more years. If I wanted more money, I wouldn't be here. I had somewhere to go to get much more money than being at Manchester United," Fernandes said.
"I could have been in a place that's much warmer than Manchester."
New manager Mauricio Pochettino, appointed after Michael Carrick was sacked earlier this month, will take charge of his first game when United face fifth-placed Liverpool on Sunday.

items.title: Shiba Inu Team Makes Key GitHub Clarification for ShibaSwap, Shibarium
items.summary: "Shib.io is home to both Shibarium and ShibaSwap," Shiba Inu developer and long-time community member Mazrael said, citing the project’s public Git repository as evidence of the longstanding ...
items.body:
News
/ U.Today
/ Shiba Inu Team Makes Key GitHub Clarification for ShibaSwap, Shibarium

Shiba Inu Team Makes Key GitHub Clarification for ShibaSwap, Shibarium 2 min read

SHIBUSD BONEUSD
"Shib.io is home to both Shibarium and ShibaSwap," Shiba Inu developer and long-time community member Mazrael said, citing the project’s public Git repository as evidence of the longstanding relationship.
Mazrael recently spoke about the link between the official web presence of the Shiba Inu ecosystem and its decentralized platforms in a post, stating that the information has been consistent since the launch of ShibaSwap.

Mazrael.shib
@Mazrael_shib

@Heisenbergiqr3 @tacitfi @randhindi @LCSHIB @Shibtoken https://t.co/RP8CH8r1zW is home of Shibarium and Shibaswap as indicated in our public git that has not changed since Shibaswap and is the same git for shibarium

Nov 21, 2026

Mazrael says the public Git repository has not changed since the launch of ShibaSwap and is the same repository that is used for Shibarium. The clarification seems intended to quell confusion on Shiba Inu's official channels as legacy domains become decommissioned. He pointed to the project’s public Git as proof that Shib.io is the home of Shibarium and ShibaSwap.
The clarification strengthens the link among Shib.io, ShibaSwap and Shibarium, two key components of the Shiba Inu ecosystem.
Mazrael's reference to the unchanged public Git repository also highlights the team's position that this connection is not a recent development but part of the project's established infrastructure.
In the latest development for Shibarium, Mazrael announced that CreateX is now live on the Shiba Inu Layer 2.
Shiba Inu price rebounds
Shiba Inu has climbed back above $0.0000035, recovering from Saturday's low of $0.00000337, its weakest level in years. It’s trading near $0.0000036, up 3.23% in the last 24 hours.
The broader crypto market is seeing a short-term rebound, but it does not fully establish that the decline has ended. According to Santiment, “Stablecoin Whale Dry Powder Continues Shrinking Across Crypto.”
The largest tracked stablecoin whales are holding far less dry powder than before, Santiment stated, noting that since the start of the year, USDT balances on Ethereum held by the top 100 whales have fallen by $15.14 billion (-21.1%) and USDC (on Ethereum) balances are down $6.72 billion (-23.7%).
Stablecoins are crypto’s ready-to-deploy cash, so large whale balances can represent potential buying power for BTC and altcoins. Falling balances can mean funds were deployed, redeemed, transferred elsewhere, or moved outside these tracked wallets. Either way, having less USDT and USDC concentrated among major holders means less obvious dry powder waiting on the sidelines.

Ferrari chief frustrated with latest Leclerc-Hamilton collision

LAS VEGAS, Nov 22 : Ferrari principal Fred Vasseur said Charles Leclerc's collision with teammate Lewis Hamilton at the Las Vegas Grand Prix on Saturday was "completely unacceptable".
The incident came weeks after the Ferrari pair had collided at the Mexico City race, prompting talks within the team aimed at preventing a repeat.
Vasseur said the latest clash was particularly frustrating given Ferrari had addressed the issue with both drivers after Mexico and again in Brazil.
Leclerc received a 10-second penalty over the incident and finished 10th, while Hamilton, who was penalised for an earlier incident, finished seventh.

"Clearly it's unacceptable, first," Vasseur told Sky Italia. "A bit the same message as Mexico because you have to think about the team, about the people working in Maranello, about all the stakeholders, sponsors."
Leclerc had attempted to pass his teammate on the inside during the latter stages of the race but the pair made contact that spun Hamilton around.
"Charles did clearly make a mistake, that is penalising the team a lot and it's completely unacceptable today," Vasseur said.
"We had a chat all together in Brazil. Today we passed the message to think about the team when they were racing together and the outcome is this one. It's mega-frustrating for all of us."
Leclerc said he accepted responsibility as the stewards had decided to penalise him.
"I've been penalised so as a result I guess the majority and the stewards thought that it was my mistake, which I'll accept," the Monegasque driver added.
"I'm not going to say much more. At the end of the day I'm penalised so it has to be my mistake.
"I just feel quite embarrassed for the team in general. We will review."
Hamilton was reluctant to discuss the clash with Leclerc.
"I'm not going to get into the scenario. That's something for you to speak to Ferrari about," Hamilton said.
"But we knew that we were faced with a massive challenge this weekend. We didn't realise there would be such a limitation on the straights, and qualifying obviously was difficult.
"In the race I felt great and I really was progressing well. We ultimately wanted to try and make sure we finished ahead of the McLarens because that's who we're really fighting in the constructors."
Hamilton was penalised on lap 12 for leaving the track and gaining an advantage while passing McLaren's Lando Norris. The seven-times world champion was unable to give the position back and said the sanction was harsh.
"Avoiding collision with one of the McLarens got me a 10-second penalty, which was, I think, really harsh," he said. "I got my head back down and just kept chasing, managed to get back in the fight and then got knocked back again.
"But I never gave up and was just trying to get the best result. I really think we could have had a podium today with the pace we had."
Asked whether Ferrari needed firmer internal rules for racing Hamilton said that was a matter for the team.
"That's for Ferrari to decide, honestly," he said. "I've done all I can and I've said everything and more. It's been difficult. So all I can do is just show up and give it everything I can and hope in the background they eventually figure it out."

Source: Reuters

LAS VEGAS, Nov 21 : McLaren's Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri said they were pleased to put last year's double disqualification at the Las Vegas Grand Prix behind them after finishing second and third on Saturday.
Norris had started from pole position and finished second in Las Vegas last year, while Piastri crossed the line fourth, but both were later disqualified for excessive skid plank wear.
On Saturday, Norris and Piastri followed home race winner Max Verstappen, with Piastri joking that he would save his celebrations until the final technical checks were complete.
"I don't know if we're past scrutineering yet. I'm hoping we have," the Australian told reporters. "No, it's good. And yeah, in the context of this year's championship it's exactly what we needed.

"So I'm very happy about that. But yeah, I'm not going to solidify my comments until we have actually passed scrutineering."
McLaren won the constructors' championship last year but are fourth this season, nine points behind Red Bull in third. Mercedes have already sealed the constructors' championship, ahead of Ferrari in second place.
Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli won the drivers' championship earlier this month. Norris is fifth in the standings, on the same points total as Mercedes driver George Russell, while Piastri is seventh.
Norris said what happened in Las Vegas last year had been consigned to history and that McLaren had not arrived in Nevada looking to make up for that disappointment.
"What happened last year happened last year, so it's not like you come here to try and make up for what happened," he added.
"It was a freak thing that shouldn't have happened. Didn't gain us an advantage, it was just unfortunate.
"So yeah, it's a separate year and I'm happy that we just finished any race to be honest."

XRP Ledger Loses 60% of Users 1 min read

XRPUSD
XRP Ledger's network activity has dropped sharply, losing around 60% of the users it had yesterday. The decline comes amid a serious price correction and increased pressure on the cryptocurrency market. Selling pressure remains high, and the declining number of users is not helping the price.
Fuel for the correction
XRPScan's data showed 250,000 users 24 hours ago, while today's reading shows barely 92,000 users. While the drop is significant, it should not be considered critical on its own. The decline partly reflects a regular weekend slowdown, when traders are generally less active, but it comes alongside the price correction and broader selling pressure.

BITSTAMP:XRPUSDT Chart by TradingView">
The highest point for this metric in November was 300,000, with a monthly average of approximately 200,000 active users. The number of users is a critical metric for the network's health, and a decline toward 100,000 often comes before bullish sentiment among investors. The current drop does not guarantee that sentiment will turn, especially as the price remains under pressure.
Price action remains weak
Apart from the negative on-chain trend, XRP's price performance has also been weak. The price lost roughly 5% from its November 19 close and even fell below the $0.90 price level, which was expected to serve as a foundation for recovery. XRP was around $0.915 on November 22 after closing at $0.9604 three days earlier.
The trend remains bearish, and the decline could become significantly worse.
Few expected a surge in market liquidations so soon, as Bitcoin fell below the $60,000 price level. XRP and other altcoins followed the broader market trend and suffered serious losses.
Interest in the network appears to be weakening as the price correction continues, so this drop in activity is not helping XRP's recovery.
A potential recovery above $0.9 could be the key to a quick rebound. However, the overall trend remains bearish and is unlikely to change unless significant market events occur.

LAS VEGAS, Nov 21 : Red Bull's Max Verstappen laughed at George Russell's misfortune on Saturday after the Dutchman won the Las Vegas Grand Prix while his Mercedes rival went into the barriers and finished ninth.
Russell had challenged Verstappen for the lead but ended up fighting to salvage something after the late drama in a chaotic Formula One race of slipstreaming and nose-to-tail action.
The pair, who are vying for the runners-up spot in the drivers' standings behind Mercedes' new champion Kimi Antonelli, have clashed repeatedly over the years, on and off track.
They made contact in final practice in Las Vegas that landed Verstappen with a stewards' warning, while Russell accused the Dutchman on Friday of trying to "screw me over" and vowed to stand up to him.

"He speaks a lot next to the track," Verstappen told the post-race press conference of Russell. "It doesn't really bother me because he's so far below my level that it doesn't really make any sense for me to try and challenge that.
"And today karma is a bitch. It was honestly fantastic when I looked in my mirror and I saw what was happening.
"So I was like 'fantastic. My day's only getting better'."
Canada's 1997 world champion Jacques Villeneuve, a pundit for Sky Sports television, winced at the comments.
"The comments are there to hurt, to put in his terms George in place," he said. "From the outside you just have to laugh and find the fun in the words that are being used."
Russell said he had no regrets about the move that left him in the barriers.
"I felt like I had to go for it if I wanted to win the race," he added.
"In a race like this it was sort of high risk, high reward and with two laps remaining I kind of really wanted to be behind Max going into that last lap and obviously just got it very slightly wrong, and with the lockup it was unavoidable.
"So obviously disappointed and a bit frustrated with it."
(Writing by Alan Baldwin in London; Editing by Peter Rutherford)

items.title: ＣＯＰ３１議長国が合意文書の新草案、脱化石燃料に直接言及せず　合意不透明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tuvan Gumrukcu　Ali Kucukgocmen

［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Tuvan Gumrukcu　Ali Kucukgocmen

［アンタルヤ（トルコ） ２２日　ロイター］ - トルコのアンタルヤで開催中の国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）は会期延長２日目となる２２日、共同議長国のトルコとオーストラリアが合意文書の新たな草案を公表した。各国の代表団が異議を申し立てられるよう数時間の猶予を設定した。合意案の承認手続きを始める会合を２２日中に開く予定だが、先行きは不透明。合意に至らない可能性も出ている。

新草案は、気候変動対策の国際枠組み「パリ協定」が目指す産業革命前からの世界の気温上昇を１．５度に抑えるとの目標を超える軌道にあることを、初めて認める。その上で、超過分を最終的に押し戻すため、炭素除去技術の開発加速を求める。焦点となっていた気候変動の原因とされる化石燃料からの脱却には直接には触れず、その代わり、脱却を進めるとした過去の合意文書に言及した。

協議に詳しい関係筋によると、サウジアラビアやその他の主要産油国は、文書に化石燃料の記載は入れず、炭素除去技術を盛り込むよう強く働きかけていたという。

ツバルのマイナ・タリア気候変動相は「まるでサウジと交渉しているようだ」と話した。 サウジ代表はコメントを控えた。

ＣＯＰ３１の議長を務めるトルコのムラト・クルム環境・都市計画・気候変動相は「われわれは、全ての締約国が合意できる文案を提示できたと考えている。妥協が見えてきている」と述べた。

しかし匿名を条件に取材に応じた複数の代表団は、合意しないまま会議を終える可能性に言及した。

環境団体「３５０．ｏｒｇ」は、草案が化石燃料に明示的に言及せず、炭素除去技術の推進を訴えている点に失望を表明。団体の幹部、サラ・ショー氏は「炭素回収はオーバーシュート時代で最大級の詐欺で、われわれの指導者はそれにだまされる寸前だ」と批判した。 

二酸化炭素（ＣＯ２）を大気中に放出される前に取り込む炭素回収技術については、費用がかさむうえに大規模な実用化が実証されておらず、合意に盛り込めば石油・ガス開発の継続に道を開くことになるとの批判的な指摘も出ている。

The governor of Washington state denounced federal immigration authorities on Saturday (Nov 21) for arresting two people on a jetway at a Seattle-area airport.
The incident involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers occurred around 8am PST at the Seattle-Tacoma International Airport as people boarded an Alaska Airlines flight to Los Angeles. ICE officers conducted an operation to arrest Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, who overstayed his visa, the agency said in a statement.
The officers also arrested a second individual, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, who threw hot coffee at them, ICE said in a post on social media. Mejia had also overstayed her visa, ICE said, adding that she would be charged with assaulting a federal officer.
Reuters was not able to identify lawyers for Mendoza or Mejia.

"ICE is completely and totally out of control and today we are confronted with yet more evidence of this," said Governor Bob Ferguson, a Democrat, at a news conference on Saturday.
Video of the incident circulated on social media and news outlets is "horrific" and "chilling", Ferguson said, adding that he told Alaska Airlines representatives that “they need to call on ICE to get out of our airports."
The governor said he would make the same request of every other airline that flies out of Sea-Tac airport.
Alaska Airlines said it is "concerned" by the federal action.
"Alaska Airlines was not provided advance notice of the enforcement action and we are working to understand the circumstances surrounding what occurred," the company said in a statement.
April Sims, president of the Washington State Labor Council called the ICE arrest a "smash-and-grab" action that injected fear and chaos during a delicate time for air travel.
"Just days after our nation experienced widespread disruptions to air travel and flights being grounded, federal agents chose to carry out this operation at one of our busiest airports, during one the busiest travel weeks of the year," Sims said in a statement sent by the union, which includes local chapters representing flight attendants and ground crew at Sea-Tac airport.
Alaska Airlines said many passengers were put on other flights shortly after the incident and the originally scheduled flight departed at 11am.

Reuters was not able to identify lawyers for Mendoza or Mejia.

items.title: Agenda de la semana: PIB y PCE en EE.UU., inflación en Brasil y México y actividad en Argentina
items.author: Lizeth Ortega
items.summary: Los mercados seguirán de cerca los datos de crecimiento e inflación en Estados Unidos, mientras América Latina estará pendiente de los indicadores de precios en Brasil y México y de la actividad econó ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — La agenda económica del 23 al 27 de noviembre estará marcada por la publicación de indicadores clave en América Latina, entre ellos la inflación de mediados de noviembre en Brasil, la actividad económica de Argentina y la inflación quincenal de México. En Estados Unidos, la atención de los mercados se centrará en los datos del PIB y el informe de ingresos y gastos personales, que incluye el índice de precios de gastos de consumo personal (PCE), la medida de inflación preferida por la Reserva Federal (Fed). Los resultados podrían ofrecer nuevas señales sobre la evolución de los precios antes de la decisión de tasas de interés de diciembre. En el frente internacional, los líderes de la Unión Europea tienen prevista una reunión extraordinaria del Consejo Europeo en Bruselas, mientras que el Banco Central Europeo (BCE) publicará las actas de su reunión de política monetaria de octubre. Ver más: México se dispone a publicar normas sobre las comisiones de las tarjetas para impulsar los pagos digitales De acuerdo con un análisis de Bloomberg Economics elaborado por los economistas Felipe Hernández y Adriana Dupita, junto con la analista Jimena Zúñiga, la atención de los mercados regionales se concentrará en los indicadores de actividad económica e inflación, así como en las perspectivas de política monetaria. En México, el informe trimestral de inflación del Banco de México (Banxico) incluirá pronósticos actualizados y una evaluación más detallada de las perspectivas de política monetaria. Los analistas prevén que las nuevas proyecciones de inflación estén, en términos generales, alineadas con las publicadas tras la reunión de noviembre. En Argentina, un fuerte repunte de los indicadores adelantados apunta a una recuperación significativa de la actividad económica en septiembre, según Bloomberg Economics. “Sin embargo, incluso un repunte marcado podría no devolver la cifra interanual a terreno positivo ni evitar una contracción trimestral considerable del PIB en el tercer trimestre”, advierten los expertos. En Brasil, la atención estará puesta en el índice de inflación IPCA-15 de noviembre. Los analistas anticipan que los precios de los alimentos seguirán bajo presión y que los costos del transporte probablemente aumentarán, pese a una ligera caída en los precios de la gasolina. Ver más: Morgan Stanley rebaja a Brasil y revela sus apuestas en América Latina para 2027 -Y para conocer las variables que orientan a los inversores, sigue la ruta de los mercados -Con información de Bloomberg Economics

items.title: Oil, gas import bill up 60% in Oct as Brent surges, LPG use declines
items.author: Press Trust of India
items.summary: Direct private LPG imports fell 83.8 per cent in October and 97.3 per cent in April-October. Packed domestic LPG sales by state-run companies fell 11.8 per cent in October, and bulk LPG sales fell ...
items.body: India's net oil and gas import bill rose 60 per cent year-on-year to $16 billion in October as Brent crude averaged $124.77 a barrel, almost double that of a year earlier, according to data from the Petroleum Planning and Analysis Cell (PPAC), part of the oil ministry.The net bill was $10.0 billion in October 2025. Crude imports alone cost $19.5 billion, against $10.4 billion a year ago, even though volumes rose only 11 per cent to 23.3 million tonnes. LNG imports cost $1.3 billion, and petroleum product exports brought in $6.3 billion.Brent averaged $116.77 in September and $64.75 in October 2025. The Indian basket averaged $119.91 in October, against $65.08 a year earlier.Over April-October, the net import bill reached $97.7 billion, up from $70.3 billion a year earlier. Crude imports rose 2.7 per cent in volume but cost $111.0 billion, against $72.3 billion.Consumption of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) fell 12.3 per cent in October and 15.1 per cent in April-October. The number of active domestic LPG customers stood at 32.6 crore on November 1, down from 33.4 crore on April 1, the PPAC data showed.Direct private LPG imports fell 83.8 per cent in October and 97.3 per cent in April-October. Packed domestic LPG sales by state-run companies fell 11.8 per cent in October, and bulk LPG sales fell 49.1 per cent. Auto LPG sales rose 23.9 per cent.Imports of petroleum products fell 41.2 per cent in October and 49.3 per cent in the fiscal year so far. PPAC attributed the fiscal-year decline mainly to lower imports of LPG, pet coke and fuel oil.The International Energy Agency said in its World Energy Outlook 2026 that LPG imports fell by over 50 per cent in the first two months of shipping disruption through the Strait of Hormuz.Other fuels held up better. Diesel consumption rose 12 per cent in October to 8.5 million tonnes, petrol rose 3.5 per cent, and bitumen rose 16.5 per cent. Total petroleum product consumption rose 2.7 per cent to 20.5 million tonnes in October. It was still down 3.2 per cent in April-October at 134.2 million tonnes.Natural gas consumption fell 7.27 per cent to 5,707 million standard cubic metres in October. LNG imports fell 6.94 per cent to 3,014 million standard cubic metres.India processed 24.1 million tonnes of crude in October, up 7.1 per cent, or about 5.70 million barrels a day. Of that, 22.0 million tonnes were imported crude, and domestic output was 2.1 million tonnes. Imports met 88.7 per cent of crude consumption in October.Domestic crude and condensate output was 2.3 million tonnes. Import dependency for natural gas stood at 52.8 per cent in October.Ethanol blending in petrol stood at 20 per cent in October, PPAC data showed.

COP31 climate talks set to collapse without a political agreement UN climate negotiations at COP31 in Turkey face a breakdown after the summit president ruled out a fresh draft agreement amid a lack of consensus among countries.

COP31 climate negotiations in Antalya, Turkey, face uncertainty as countries remain divided over the proposed agreement, with the summit president ruling out a fresh draft text. | Image: Reuters

Reuters 1 min read Last Updated : Nov 22 2026 | 7:01 PM IST

Listen to This Article

UN climate talks in Turkey looked ??set to collapse without a political agreement after COP31 summit president Murat Kurum said there would be no new draft of the deal.
  Earlier, multiple countries and negotiating blocs said they could not accept the version of the text put before them.
  "There will be no new text ??from now on. We will not be carrying out work on a new text in an environment where there is no consensus," Kurum said.

items.title: ＥＵ加盟国はロシア人の入国制限強化を、デンマークが提案　暗殺未遂受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
John Irish

[パリ ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
John Irish

[パリ ２１日 ロイター] - デンマークは、米ウクライナ二重国籍の男性ラッパーに対するロシアの暗殺計画を阻止したと発表したのに続き、欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟国に文書を送り、ロシア国民への入国制限を強化するよう呼びかけた。外交関係者が文書の内容を確認した。

デンマークの警察と治安当局は２０日、ロシア情報機関が９月下旬にコペンハーゲンで公演を控えていた男性ラッパーの暗殺を企てたが、直前に関係する３人を逮捕したと明らかにした。ラスムセン外相はこれを「容認できない」と非難し、デンマーク政府はロシアの駐在武官の国外追放も発表した。

デンマークはＥＵ加盟国の外交担当者に２０日夜に送った文書で、欧州域内の自由な往来を保障するシェンゲン協定締結２９カ国への入国に関し、ロシア国民への観光ビザ（査証）の発給停止や、ロシアの非生体認証パスポートでの本人確認を停止することを提案した。

週明け２３日に開かれるＥＵの事務レベルの会議で提案を示す見通し。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）は２１日、各地で試合を行い、八村塁が所属するクリッパーズはマーベリックスに１００─１１０で敗れた。

先発した八村は約２９分プレーし、１９得点、８リバウンド、１アシストだった。クリッパーズは３連敗。

セブンティシクサーズはバックスを１３２─１２９で下し、５連勝。東カンファレンストップの１４勝３敗とした。シクサーズのジョエル・エンビードが２６得点、１７リバウンド、９アシストと活躍。レブロン・ジェームズが２１得点、６リバウンド、６アシスト、３スチールで貢献した。バックスはタイラー・ヒーローがキャリア最多の５０得点を挙げたが、１３連敗となった。

スパーズはビクター・ウェンバンヤマが５０得点、１９リバウンドと活躍し、ペリカンズに１１４─９１で快勝した。ティンバーウルブズはグリズリーズに１０４─９５で勝利。ニックスはトレイルブレーザーズに９７─９６で競り勝った。

items.title: Wall Street asks what can save AI trade after Anthropic wipeout
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: Wall Street is struggling to find reasons to buy as the AI trade comes under pressure following Anthropic’s lacklustre post-IPO performance. A sharp selloff in tech stocks, mounting concerns over AI-related risks and an expected Federal Reserve rate hike have dampened investor sentiment, leaving markets searching for fresh catalysts to revive the rally.
items.body: It’s been a tough month for the stock market, rocked by back-to-back punches from the stunning ouster of Jensen Huang from Nvidia Corp. and the Democrats’ decisive victory in the midterm elections.Anthropic PBC’s record-breaking initial public offering this week was supposed to provide some relief and change the mood. It didn’t. Instead, it raised more questions about the struggling artificial intelligence trade, and tech stocks continued to sell off, led by chipmakers, with Nasdaq 100 Index tumbling 10% for the week, its worst performance since the Covid pandemic hit in March 2020.Now, with few positive catalysts and a series of obvious risks on the horizon, starting with the Federal Reserve’s expected interest-rate hike next month, Wall Street is wondering what will inspire stocks to start climbing again. Instead of finding inspiration to buy, investors just keep discovering reasons to sell, as seemingly every other news headline — from air travel shutdowns to financial hacks — fuels suspicion that technology isn’t adapting to the risks posed by AI.“The market is in limbo-land, especially when it comes to tech and AI,” said Paul Nolte, market strategist and senior wealth manager at Murphy & Sylvest Wealth Management. “You need to gird your loins and expect a period of volatility and downside risk.”136067477The Anthropic deal could mark the end of the AI trade, Anna Wong, an economist with Bloomberg Economics, wrote in a report on Thursday. The company’s financials show weakening pricing power for frontier intelligence, she wrote, meaning that even with all the demand for AI services, leading providers are having trouble getting customers to pay enough for it to justify their spending.Of course, in a vacuum, Anthropic’s IPO did fine. It was priced over its targeted range, and when combined with a separate private placement of shares, the company raised the most cash for a new issue ever, topping SpaceX’s deal in June. The stock even raced higher out of the gate. But it quickly plateaued and then started retreating. By the end of Friday it was less than $6 from where it went public.The bigger issue is it ushered in more selling rather than giving investors a reason to buy. By the end of Friday, the Nasdaq 100 was teetering on the brink of bear market, defined as a 20% decline from a recent high, while the S&P 500 Index had entered a correction after falling 12% from its October record.Skeptical TimesAll that selling laid bare the magnitude of the questions swirling around AI more than four years into a bull market powered by huge bets on the technology.“There was a hope that the Anthropic IPO would provide a sustained boost, but the trading there is indicative of the broader concerns surrounding AI,” said Jim Baird, chief investment officer at Plante Moran Financial Advisors. “Anthropic came to market at a time of more general skepticism surrounding the space, and there are a lot of questions about their ability in the near term to deliver on increasingly lofty expectations.”Democratic victories in the midterms raised the risk that data center construction will slow since many of the party’s candidates ran on blocking their development. Meanwhile, the risk of higher interest rates raises the cost of capital as big data center developers increasingly turn to credit markets for funding.“A lot of the growth in AI is dependent on how and whether companies can fund their capital needs,” said Malcolm Polley, director of strategic market analysis at Stratos Investment Management, which has $3.6 billion in assets. “Will they need to fund that through capital or debt markets? Until we know the cost of capital, we can’t adequately value the asset, and if the cost of capital is going higher, then valuations need to come down.”But it’s the chaos at Nvidia that really has spooked investors. The company ousted Huang on Nov. 12 after he admitted having an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China, and the stock has been in a tailspin ever since. Even a strong earnings report featuring a raised revenue forecast for next fiscal year and a $150 billion stock buyback authorization couldn’t stop the selling, as the question remained who will be Huang’s permanent replacement.Nvidia shares plunged 23% this week, their worst performance since 2008. The stock is down 48% from an Oct. 6 all-time high.The turmoil appeared to create openings for Nvidia’s competitors, including chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices Inc. But that bet took a hit on Thursday when a short seller raised questions about AMD’s business in China, which could be hurt by more US chip export restrictions. The shares plunged 20% in the final two sessions of the week.More broadly, it’s the sustainability of the hundreds of billions of dollars being spent to expand computing power that’s driving the selloff. That spending has juiced earnings for companies across the AI ecosystem, from chipmakers and networking gear manufacturers to electricity providers and industrial companies. But investors are increasingly skeptical that it can last.Chip Stocks SwingThis rapid swing from greed to fear is best seen in the trading of semiconductor stocks this year. Chips are historically a cyclical business, rising with demand and then falling as it dissipates. But the belief was that this history would be rewritten as years of AI demand would break the cycle. The Philadelphia Stock Exchange Semiconductor Index more than doubled in the first half of the year on that bet. But it has lost 41% in the second half as investors rethink those positions.136067484Memory and storage stocks, which also are major beneficiaries of the AI spending, have been among the hardest hit over the last few months. Sandisk Corp. was leading the S&P 500 in the first six months of year, soaring 857%. It’s the worst stock in the index in the second half, dropping 72%. Western Digital Corp. has tumbled more than 65% from a June record, while Micron Technology Inc. is down more than 50% from its all-time high.Of course, some optimism remains on Wall Street. In particular the hope is the selloff is nearing exhaustion as investors have used the opportunity to reduce risk, according to Brian Smedley, chief investment officer and head of Cynosure Strategies, the hedge fund division of the Cynosure Group.“I think investors will gain confidence that AI demand remains exceptionally strong, and that the key players — Anthropic among them — will continue to have very healthy growth prospects,” he said. “The market has overshot to the downside, just as it overshot to the upside earlier this year.”One thing investors agree on is that Anthropic’s debut will provide a new level of visibility into the business of selling AI services.“It has been hard to get a real feel for AI demand, and Anthropic is the answer to that question,” said Marta Norton, chief investment strategist at Empower. “We will know more about the upside of AI, in terms of demand and the return, at the same time that we will be getting a reinforced view of how crazy wildly expensive it is.”In the meantime, strategists are advising clients to stay nimble.“It’s hard to say what it might take to catalyze gains after this week,” said Mark Luschini, chief market strategist at Janney Montgomery Scott. “I want to see whether this selloff metastasizes into something more severe. We’re oversold, but not deeply so. We could plumb lower still. I want to see stabilization before I make a strong commitment.”
items.raw_description: Wall Street is struggling to find reasons to buy as the AI trade comes under pressure following Anthropic’s lacklustre post-IPO performance. A sharp selloff in tech stocks, mounting concerns over AI-related risks and an expected Federal Reserve rate hike have dampened investor sentiment, leaving markets searching for fresh catalysts to revive the rally.

items.title: テニス＝ＡＴＰファイナル、決勝はズベレフ対アルカラス
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの今季ツアー最終戦、ＡＴＰファイナルは２１日、イタリアのトリノで準決勝を行い、決勝は世界ランキング１位のアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）と世界３位のカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）という顔合わせになった。

ズベレフは第４シードでロシア出身のダニル・メドベージェフと対戦し、第１セットはタイブレークで７ポイントを連取して７─６でものにすると、第２セットは６─４で勝利。今大会では１セットも落とさずに決勝まで進んだ。

自身３回目のＡＴＰファイナル制覇を目指すズベレフは「どちらも信じられないほど素晴らしいサーブを打っていたので、（ブレークポイントは）ほとんどなかったような気がする。彼（メドベージェフ）をたたえたい」と話した。

アルカラスは第３シードのベン・シェルトン（米国）に３─６、６─３、７─６で逆転勝利。「第２セットでいいプレーをして巻き返せたのがとにかくうれしい。タイブレークでも素晴らしいテニスができて満足している。この勝利には大きな意味がある。明日が楽しみだ。今日は全てに満足している」と話した。

アルカラスは優勝すればＡＴＰファイナル初タイトル。ズベレフとの対戦成績は７勝６敗としており、ことしの全豪オープン準決勝でもフルセットの末に勝利を収めている。

items.title: サッカー＝レアル、エムバペＰＫ失敗もセルタに逆転勝ち
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は２１日、各地で試合を行い、レアル・マドリードがセルタに２─１で勝利し、翌日に試合を控える首位バルセロナと暫定ながら勝ち点３３で並んだ。

前半６分に失点したレアルは、同３９分にキリアン・エムバペが自ら得たＰＫで同点のチャンスを得るも、これを失敗。同選手がレアルとフランス代表での試合中にＰＫを外したのは直近６回中これが３回目となった。

レアルは後半２１分、エムバペのアシストからジュード・ベリンガムが同点弾をマークすると、同４０分にカルロス・エスピが決勝ゴールを決めた。

佐藤龍之介が所属するバレンシアはラヨ・バリェカノに１─０で勝利し、暫定１７位に浮上して降格圏内を脱出。佐藤はベンチ入りしたが出番はなかった。

その他、セビリアとベティスのダービーは１─１のドロー。アラベスはデポルティボに３─１で勝利した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - ノルディックスキーのワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）ジャンプは２１日、リレハンメルで男女の個人第１戦（ヒルサイズ＝ＨＳ１４０メートル）を行い、男子では小林陵侑が８位だった。

小林は１回目に１３５メートル、２回目に１２６．５メートルを飛び、合計２４４．２点だった。シュテファン・エンバハー（オーストリア）が合計２７８．０点で優勝した。中村直幹は１１位、佐藤幸椰は２３位。二階堂蓮は２回目に進めず、３７位に終わった。

女子では丸山希が合計２１６．８点で９位。宮嶋林湖は１１位、勢藤優花は１４位、伊藤有希は１９位で、高梨沙羅は２回目に進めずに３５位だった。優勝したアイリンマリア・クバンダルを含め、５位までノルウェー勢が独占した。

items.title: Anthropic's post-debut stumble delivers reality check for AI trade
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Anthropic’s shares fell about 9% after their market debut, deepening concerns over stretched AI valuations and showing that even a marquee listing has not revived investor enthusiasm for the sector. The focus is now shifting to whether Anthropic can justify its roughly 40-times-sales valuation and whether a potential OpenAI IPO next year can restore appetite for AI stocks.
items.body: Anthropic's post-listing slide deepened the gloom over the AI sector on Friday, underscoring how even one of the most eagerly anticipated listings in history has struggled to revive investor enthusiasm.Widely seen as a proxy for the AI trade, Anthropic's listing had been viewed as a potential boost for an industry struggling to regain momentum after a turbulent stretch.But the stock was last trading at $88.87, about 9% below where it closed following Thursday's smooth debut, giving Anthropic a fully diluted valuation of about $1.6 trillion and a market capitalization of $1.2 trillion based on shares outstanding.The stock could find support later in the year. London-based index rebalance analytics firm Intropic estimates index-tracking funds could account for purchases of up to 30% of Anthropic's shares by year-end.Near-term volatility, however, could persist as the initial euphoria around the listing fades and investors assess whether a valuation of about 40 times sales over the past 12 months can be sustained. We favor patience on Anthropic and recommend evaluating the company as it reports public results, said Kaush Amin, head of private market investing at US Bank Asset Management, adding that the current valuation assumes years of rapid growth. The debut has also done little to ease broader concerns about the health of the AI trade. Wall Street's main indexes ended sharply lower on Thursday, while futures pointed to further declines on Friday.Among the Magnificent Seven stocks, Nvidia and Meta Platforms fell more than 2% each in premarket trading, while Amazon and Microsoft dropped more than 1%.Chip stocks also slid, with AMD and Sandisk down 7% each and Intel losing more than 5%.The focus now shifts to a potential OpenAI listing, which would be another major test of investors' appetite for AI stocks. OpenAI has indicated it may go public next year.PARALLELS WITH SPACEXAnthropic's IPO has drawn parallels with Elon Musk's SpaceX , which went public in June after the second-biggest IPO on record.While the companies have different business models, some investors have pointed to SpaceX's sharp swings in the weeks after its debut as a reason for caution over buying Anthropic immediately after its listing. There's going to be some volatility like we had with SpaceX. A lot of people are going to have FOMO. I don't think there's any need to get on it on the first trade, said Rob Hackel, CEO of financial advisory and brokerage firm RF Lafferty & Co.SpaceX shares fell about 5%.Retail investors traded about $772 million of Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most for an IPO debut since Vanda Research began tracking the data in 2012.The stock's sharp swings have left investors weighing whether to bet on a rebound or brace for further losses. Options trading, due to begin next week, could add to the volatility. It's not a good environment for Anthropic at the moment, said Carsten Hesse, head of index events at Berenberg.Competition could also weigh on investor sentiment.Apple is developing an AI agent that can perform tasks on behalf of users, entering a market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.

The focus is now shifting to whether Anthropic can justify its roughly 40-times-sales valuation and whether a potential OpenAI IPO next year can restore appetite for AI stocks.

items.title: ラグビー＝ネーションズ選手権、日本はスコットランドに大敗
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［エディンバラ　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［エディンバラ　２１日　ロイター］ - ラグビーの強豪１２カ国・地域で争う国際大会、ネーションズ選手権は２１日、英国のエディンバラなどで試合を行い、世界ランキング１２位の日本代表は同６位のスコットランド代表に５─６７で大敗した。

日本はスピードとパワーで圧倒され、合計１１トライを献上。前半に０─２９と大差をつけられると、後半にも失点を重ね、松永拓朗による１トライにとどまった。

同大会では北半球と南半球のチームが戦い、南の一員として参戦している日本は１勝５敗で５位。北のスコットランドは４勝２敗で４位となった。

エディー・ジョーンズ・ヘッドコーチ率いる日本は１１月に入って３戦全敗。７日はウェールズに２１─２８で敗れ、１４日はイングランドに１５─７８の完敗を喫していた。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［マンチェスター（英国）　２１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［マンチェスター（英国）　２１日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは２１日、各地で試合を行い、坂元達裕がフル出場したコベントリーが鎌田大地フル出場のクリスタルパレスに３─２で競り勝った。

コベントリーは１─１と追い付かれて迎えた前半３０分、ペナルティーエリアの外でボールを受けた坂元が胸トラップから左足で強烈なミドルシュートをたたき込み、リーグ戦今季２ゴール目。チームは同アディショナルタイムに再び同点とされたが、最後は相手のオウンゴールで勝利を収めた。

最下位のクリスタルパレスはこれで今季８敗目。トーマス・フランク監督の初陣を白星で飾ることができなかった。クリスタルパレスの冨安健洋はベンチ外。

田中碧が先発したリーズはチェルシーを４─１で撃破。前半２５分に先制されたが、ノア・オカフォーの２ゴールなどで逆転勝利を収めた。チェルシーはリーグ戦直近４試合で３敗目となった。田中は後半４１分までプレーした。

ＧＫ鈴木彩艶がフル出場したアストンビラはサンダーランドとスコアレスドローに終わった。前田大然が先発し後半１１分までプレーしたイプスウィッチは、トットナムに０─２で完敗した。

アーセナルはニューカッスルと２─２の引き分けに終わり、勝ち点を積み上げるチャンスを逸した。マンチェスター・シティーはフラムと１─１のドローで試合を終え、リーグ戦４連敗を免れた。

１１試合消化時点で首位アーセナルは勝ち点２８。リーズは同１７として６位に浮上した。コベントリーは同１２で１３位となった。

items.title: メキシコ、麻薬組織の首領を拘束　米当局が協力
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Sarah Kinosian

[メキシコ市 ２１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Sarah Kinosian

[メキシコ市 ２１日 ロイター] - メキシコ当局は２１日、軍が２０日夜に麻薬組織の首領ファウスト・イシドロ・メサフロレス容疑者（通称エル・チャポ・イシドロ）を北西部シナロア州で拘束したと発表した。容疑者は米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）の最重要指名手配者１０人の一人。

メキシコ国防省はＸへの投稿で、軍の特殊部隊と国家警備隊による拘束作戦には米国の情報機関も協力したと明らかにした。メキシコ政府はトランプ米政権の圧力を受け、麻薬組織の取り締まりを強化している。

米国務省によると、メサフロレス容疑者とその麻薬組織「ベルトラン・レイバ」は２０年以上にわたり、ヘロイン、メタンフェタミン、コカイン、マリフアナ（大麻）を米国へ大量に密輸してきた。内部抗争が起きている別の麻薬組織「シナロア・カルテル」の派閥の一つと協力関係にあるという。

米国土安全保障捜査局（ＨＳＩ）はＸで、この作戦が「メキシコで最も強力なカルテルネットワークの一つに重大な打撃を与えた」と投稿。米北方軍もメキシコ軍を称えた。

items.author: CNA

Bahrain says Iranian attack hits industrial facility as air defences intercept attacks

The incidents were the latest escalation of regional hostilities since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February.

Visitors walk in front of Matam Rajab in downtown Manama, Bahrain, Nov 6, 2026. Picture taken with a mobile phone. (File photo: REUTERS/Hamad I Mohammed)

FAST

Bahrain said on Saturday (Nov 21) that an Iranian attack had hit a civilian industrial facility, causing a fire but no injuries, while Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they launched a missile-and-drone attack on US military positions in the kingdom, home to the US Navy's Fifth Fleet.
The incidents were the latest escalation of regional hostilities since the US and Israel attacked Iran in February. Since then, Gulf Arab states have been drawn into the conflict, and there have been repeated Iranian attacks across the region.
Civil Defence teams were working to contain the fire at the industrial facility, the ministry said in a post on X. It gave no details on the location or nature of the site.
Bahrain's interior ministry initially issued an alert urging residents to move to the nearest safe location because of a potential threat, without providing details. It later issued an all-clear before sending a second alert.

Later, Bahrain's Defence Force said its air defences had intercepted a number of Iranian aerial attacks. Shrapnel from the interceptions caused material damage but no casualties, it said, adding that Tehran was continuing its "systematic hostile approach" towards the kingdom.
The Revolutionary Guards, in a statement carried by Iranian state news agency IRNA, said their aerospace forces had launched a combined missile-and-drone attack on US positions at the Al-Riffa and Awali bases "in retaliation for ongoing aggression and repeated violations of Iranian airspace".
US Central Command did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on the Guards' account.
Bahrain has reported intercepting several Iranian aerial attacks in recent days. Gulf Arab states have come under repeated fire from Tehran since the war broke out.

総合優勝４回を誇るフェルスタッペンのＰＰ獲得は今季３回目で、キャリア通算５１回目。

すでに史上最年少での総合優勝を決めているキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）が最速タイムを計測したが、エンジン関連のペナルティーで５グリッド降格し、決勝では６番手からスタートする。

items.title: Vietnam’s New Land Law Could Speed Up Priority Projects but Weaken Farmers’ Bargaining Power
items.summary: Vietnam’s revised land law, effective July 2027, could speed up priority projects by allowing some land acquisition decisions before compensation plans are approved. The change could weaken farmers’ ...
items.body:
Vietnam’s New Land Law Could Speed Up Priority Projects but Weaken Farmers’ Bargaining Power Vietnam’s revised land law, effective July 2027, could speed up priority projects by allowing some land acquisition decisions before compensation plans are approved. The change could weaken farmers’ bargaining power, putting pressure on provincial authorities to value land fairly, resolve objections and pay households on time.
Devdiscourse News Desk | Updated: 22-11-2026 13:53 IST | Created: 22-11-2026 13:53 IST

Representative Image.

Country:

Vietnam

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Vietnam's National Assembly approved a revised land law on November 21, giving authorities a faster route to acquire land for certain projects. The law generally takes effect on July 1, 2027, and was passed with 466 of 479 participating deputies voting in favour. For Vietnam, the potential gain is more predictable delivery of infrastructure and industrial projects. For farmers and other land users, the change raises a more immediate question: how much influence will they have over compensation once authorities can issue an acquisition decision before the payment plan is final?

Faster land clearance could give Vietnam more predictable project timelines
Land disputes can delay projects when households challenge compensation offers they consider below market value. The revised law addresses one source of delay by changing the order of decisions. In eligible cases, authorities can issue a land acquisition decision before approving the compensation plan. An earlier National Assembly resolution already allowed accelerated land recovery in some circumstances, including for nationally important projects ordered to proceed faster and urgent public investment projects. The revised law builds on that approach.

For public agencies and developers, earlier decisions could make it easier to coordinate site preparation, construction contracts and financing. The economic gain depends on whether sites actually become available sooner. If disputes over valuation or payment carry over into later stages, the time saved on the acquisition decision could be offset by delays before construction begins.

Farmers could lose bargaining power before compensation is settled
Farmland is especially exposed because a household can lose its source of income without having to move. Chris Luong, a partner at CNC Counsel, said the faster procedure could therefore matter more for agricultural plots than for residential property. For farmers, the practical questions are how long they can keep using their land, when compensation arrives and whether a replacement plot can sustain production.

Two consent rules matter here. The earlier implementing decree identifies a route to an acquisition decision before compensation approval when more than 75% of land users agree. Reporting on the adopted law describes a separate mechanism for recovering the remaining land in a negotiated project after an investor has secured agreements covering more than 75% of both the land area and the land users. The distinction matters to developers assembling a site and to households that remain in negotiations after most neighbours have agreed.

Provincial authorities face the hardest decisions on compensation
Vietnam's government says the law gives priority to compensation in land with the same use as the land acquired. It also provides for other forms of compensation, including housing or cash, subject to the circumstances and what is available locally. That makes provincial capacity consequential. A same-use plot can help a farming household keep earning, while a cash award leaves the household to find replacement land or another source of income. The options will vary with local land supply.

Policymakers also face a timing issue. The law generally takes effect in July 2027, while the new land price schedules and adjustment coefficients are due to apply from January 1, 2028. For cases that span those dates, households and investors will need clarity on which valuation rules apply. Publishing the basis for each offer and the route for challenging it would help land users assess compensation and give developers a clearer view of likely costs.

The first cases will show whether faster decisions deliver fairer outcomes
Hanoi's proposed $28 billion Red River redevelopment shows how much can turn on compensation. Bloomberg reported that about 280,000 people live in the area covered by the project and that city officials proposed higher payments amid resistance. The dispute illustrates the stakes when a project affects homes, livelihoods and neighbourhood ties at the same time. Whether any part of the project can use an accelerated procedure depends on the applicable acquisition and resettlement rules.

The first cases under the revised law should show how provinces record consent, handle objections and sequence possession and payment. For Vietnam, the measure of success is whether priority projects reach construction sooner. For affected households, it is whether they receive compensation and livelihood support in time to replace what they lose. Tracking both outcomes would show whether the reform resolves delays or shifts their cost onto land users.

items.body:
［２１日　ロイター］ - フィギュアスケートのグランプリ（ＧＰ）シリーズ第５戦、フィンランディア杯は２１日、フィンランドのヘルシンキで競技を行い、女子では島田麻央が第２戦のスケートカナダに続く２連勝を達成。シリーズ上位６人で争われるＧＰファイナル（中国・重慶で１２月１０─１２日に開催）初進出を決めた。

ショートプログラム（ＳＰ）首位の島田は、この日のフリーでは冒頭のトリプルアクセル（３回転半ジャンプ）に成功。さらにステップやスピンで最高難度のレベル４を獲得するなどし、合計２２９．４９点をマークした。

日本選手によるＧＰデビューからの２連勝は２０１８年の紀平梨花以来で、２人目となった。今季ＧＰシリーズでは日本勢が５戦全勝。第１戦と第４戦では中井亜美、第３戦では千葉百音が優勝した。

ニーナ・ペトロキナ（エストニア）が合計２１４．０６点で２位、イザボー・レビト（米国）が合計２０７．１９点で３位に入った。住吉りをんは７位、渡辺倫果は１０位に終わった。

items.title: Google pledges $5 million to IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research
items.summary: Google has pledged $5 million to IIT Kharagpur to strengthen advanced artificial intelligence (AI) research, expand educational opportunities and develop the next generation of technology ...
items.body:
Home / Industry / News / Google pledges $5 million to IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research

Google pledges $5 million to IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research The announcement was made during the institute's platinum jubilee celebrations on November 21

The funding will primarily support applied AI research in areas such as Indic languages, agriculture, materials science and educational technology (Photo: Reuters)

Press Trust of India Kolkata 2 min read Last Updated : Nov 22 2026 | 1:39 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Google has pledged $5 million to IIT Kharagpur to strengthen advanced artificial intelligence (AI) research, expand educational opportunities and develop the next generation of technology professionals, a senior institute official said on Sunday.
The announcement was made during the institute's platinum jubilee celebrations on November 21.
IIT Kharagpur Director Suman Chakraborty told PTI that Sundar Pichai, an alumnus and CEO of Google, played a key role in facilitating the funding for IIT Kharagpur.
" We are proud of him (Sundar Pichai) as an alumnus who heads Google. We are thankful to Google for pledging the money, and Pichai assisted in IIT Kharagpur getting the money," he said.
  The funding will primarily support applied AI research in areas such as Indic languages, agriculture, materials science and educational technology.
Also Read

Google announces $5 mn funding for IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research

Cert-In flags vulnerabilities in Google Chrome, warns users of cyber risks

The grant will be channelled through three broad areas -- advanced AI research, educational opportunities, including expansion of AI training and curriculum for students and faculty, and capacity building through the development of campus AI infrastructure, frameworks and tools.
The director said another alumnus, Jyoti Chatterjee, had pledged an additional $5 million as seed endowment for developing a next-generation data initiative.
"The contributions are expected to provide a major boost to the institute's efforts to expand AI-driven innovation and enhance its role in developing skilled technology professionals," he said.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: A 10% drop for the stock market is unnerving, but it's not that unusual
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: The U.S. stock market has dropped 10 per cent from its high set last month amid concerns about the growing hurdles faced by the high-flying artificial intelligence industry.
items.body: The U.S. stock market has dropped 10 per cent from its high set last month amid concerns about the growing hurdles faced by the high-flying artificial intelligence industry. The fall for the S&P 500 is steep enough that Wall Street has a name for it: a “correction.” Such drops have happened regularly for more than a century, and market pros often view them as potentially healthy wipeouts of overdone euphoria, which could send stock prices too high if unchecked. But corrections are unnerving in the moment. And the larger fear always accompanying a correction is that it could be a warning sign of a coming “bear market,” which is what Wall Street calls a drop of at least 20 per cent. Here’s a look at what history shows about past corrections, and what market watchers are expecting going forward. What’s behind this correction? Stocks tied to the artificial intelligence boom drove the markets to all-time highs in October. But a confluence of events caused investors to question whether the enthusiasm is overblown and if the AI industry can deliver on the lofty expectations. For one, investors are worried that stock prices in AI companies shot too high and that the strong demand for memory, processors and other building blocks of data centers could fizzle out if AI proves less profitable than promised. The large sums needed to invest in technology and data centers are another concern. The industry is racing to develop more capable models and infrastructure, which requires billions of dollars, but increasingly companies are having to raise money by selling bonds to investors. Now, the Federal Reserve is expected to hike its short-term interest rate next month. That could drive up borrowing costs for AI companies, among others. More recently, investors have grown anxious about the regulatory environment under a new Congress. Newly elected Democrats are vowing to crack down on the industry amid a backlash against data centers. And two big states offering incentives for data centers, Texas and Georgia, elected Democratic governors who have vowed to stop new construction. Then there’s Nvidia. The company’s chips power the AI industry and it also provides the cash that’s helped companies across the industry to grow. The sudden downfall of Jensen Huang, its former CEO and co-founder, has punished the company’s stock and been a big factor in the broader sell-off. “Jensen Huang’s departure may have been the catalyst for this sell-off, but the underlying concerns in the technology sector have been building for some time,” said Karan Ramchandani, managing partner at Post Oak Group. “Investors have poured enormous amounts of capital into AI based on expectations of transformational growth, and we’re now entering a period where those expectations need to translate into measurable earnings and returns.” Not even the blockbuster market debut of AI lab Anthropic this week could stem the selling. Was there a tech bubble? And has it burst? Given their lofty valuations, Wall Street has been anticipating a correction in AI stocks for a while. Some who’ve referred to the run-up in the stocks a bubble think it hasn’t popped completely. “The bubble is popping and it has much further to go,” said David Trainer, head of investment research firm New Constructs. “We’re in the early innings of reconciliation with economic reality of egregious over-investment in AI. Like all other booms, this one is having its bust.” Others see the sell-off as another instance of the fear and anxiety that periodically grips the markets. Dan Ives, a financial analyst at Yorkville Ives & Co., likened the current downturn to market corrections in March 2020 around the pandemic and in April 2025 following the Trump administration’s escalation of its global trade war. But he sees the selling as panic-driven, and not a “red flag moment indicating darker times ahead for tech and the market.” “This is a painful tech sell-off that is heavily discounting this 4th Industrial Revolution thesis will take place over the next few years,” Ives wrote. “And that is the wrong move in our view.” Ramchandani sees the sell-off as more of a reevaluation of the AI sector than the bursting of a bubble. “AI isn’t going away,” she said, “but the market may be entering a phase where investors become far more selective about which companies can actually deliver on the promises.” Mark Hackett, chief market strategist at Nationwide, says the washout being led by AI stocks could ultimately prove constructive for the broader market. “If this evolves into a true flush, it may serve as the reset needed to improve positioning, sentiment, and the odds of a more sustainable rally into year-end,” he said, in a research note. How often do corrections occur? Every couple years, on average. Even during the historic, nearly 11-year-long bull market for U.S. stocks from March 2009 to February 2020, the S&P 500 stumbled to five corrections, according to research firm CFRA. Worries about everything from interest rates to trade wars to a European debt crisis caused the pullbacks. The U.S. market’s last correction was in March 2025. The last correction that did graduate into a bear market was in 2022. Through the 2022 bear market, the S&P 500 fell 25.4 per cent from Jan. 3 to Oct. 12. What typically happens after a drop like this? Looking at the 25 corrections since 1946 that managed to right themselves before turning into a bear market, the S&P 500 has taken an average of 130 days to hit bottom and lost an average of nearly 14.1 per cent along the way, according to CFRA. The index has taken an average of 112 days to recoup its losses. For the 14 declines that became bear markets, the damage is much worse. Going back to 1946, the average bear market has caused a loss of 32 per cent for the S&P 500, according to CFRA. ___ Alex Veiga, The Associated Press Business Writers Bernard Condon, Kaitlyn Huamani and Damian Troise contributed.

items.summary: ［２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２２日　ロイター］ - バーレーンは２１日、民間の工業施設がイランの攻撃を受け火災が発生したと発表した。イランの精鋭部隊、イスラム革命防衛隊は、バーレーン国内の米軍陣地に対しミサイルと無人機による攻撃を実施したと表明した。

バーレーンには米海軍第５艦隊が拠点があり、ここ１週間、イランの攻撃を複数回受けている。

バーレーン内務省は２２日、前日のイランによる攻撃で２人が負傷したと明らかにした。パキスタン人が重体でバーレーン市民は容体は安定していると説明した。

同省は２１日、具体的内容には触れず、潜在的な脅威があるとして住民に避難を呼びかける警報を発令。警報はいったん解除されたが、再び出された。

その後、バーレーン国防軍は、防空部隊がイランによる複数の空中攻撃を迎撃したと発表した。迎撃による破片で物的被害が出たものの、死傷者の報告はないとした。国防軍は、イラン政府がバーレーンに対する「組織的な敵対的アプローチ」を続けていると指摘した。

一方、イランの革命防衛隊は国営イラン通信（ＩＲＮＡ）が伝えた声明で、「継続的な侵略とイラン領空への度重なる侵犯に対する報復」として、リファー基地およびアワリ基地の米軍施設に対し、宇宙航空部隊がミサイルと無人機による複合攻撃を実施したと発表した。

米中央軍は、革命防衛隊の説明に関するロイターのコメント要請に回答していない。

items.title: ロシア貨物船に無人機攻撃、ウクライナ関与か　フィンランド領海で火災
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Essi Lehto

［ヘルシンキ　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Essi Lehto

［ヘルシンキ　２２日　ロイター］ - ロシア軍と関係のあるロシアの貨物船が２１日、バルト海で無人機（ドローン）による攻撃を受けて火災を起こした。フィンランド沿岸警備隊は２２日、消火活動が行われているものの夜間を通じて燃え続けていると発表した。フィンランド軍は、攻撃はウクライナが実行した可能性が高いとの見解を示している。

貨物船は「スパルタ２」。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、ロシア国防省向けに物流サービスを提供しているロシアの海運会社オボロンロジスティカが所有する。米国の制裁対象になっている。

フィンランド軍によると、スパルタ２はロシア領ゴーグラント島の西の公海上で攻撃を受けて損傷し、フィンランド領海内に漂流した。現在も領海内でいかりを下ろしている。乗組員１６人は近くにいたロシア船に避難した。

ウクライナは今年に入り、ロシア北西部レニングラード州に向けて軍用無人機による波状攻撃を繰り返している。一部の無人機はバルト海地域の領空に入り込み、戦争が北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の領域に影響を及ぼしているとの懸念が出ている。

オルポ首相はＸに「戦争が近隣地域に波及しつつある。フィンランド当局は、無人機攻撃でロシアの商船が被弾したフィンランド湾の状況に対応している。ウクライナには侵略者と戦う権利がある」と投稿した。

エストニアのミハル首相はＸに「ロシアの侵略と戦うことの影響がバルト海に及んだ。侵略者に（侵略を）やめるよう求める新たなシグナルだ。だが、われわれのウクライナ支援を止めるものは何もない」と投稿した。

エストニア海軍司令官のイボ・バルク氏は２２日、フィンランド湾でさらなる攻撃が行われるリスクは排除できないと公共放送ＥＲＲに語った。

items.title: Un buque de carga ruso ha sido atacado por drones en el Golfo de Finlandia
items.author: Bloomberg News
items.summary: Rusia ha afirmado que un buque de carga con destino a su enclave de Kaliningrado fue objeto de un ataque en aguas internacionales del golfo de Finlandia.
items.body: Bloomberg — Rusia ha afirmado que un buque de carga con destino a su enclave de Kaliningrado fue objeto de un ataque en aguas internacionales del golfo de Finlandia, lo que pone de relieve los crecientes riesgos para las exportaciones energéticas y alimentarias del país a través de las rutas marítimas clave del mar Báltico. Dos drones atacaron el buque a unas tres millas náuticas de la frontera marítima de Rusia, según ha declarado en Telegram el gobernador de la región de Leningrado, Alexander Drozdenko. El Ministerio de Defensa de Finlandia ha informado de que se ha enviado a la guardia fronteriza al lugar del incidente, al oeste de Suursaari —conocida en Rusia como Gogland—, en la parte oriental del golfo de Finlandia. Se están aplicando restricciones temporales a la navegación aérea y marítima como medida de precaución. El buque, el “Sparta II”, quedó a la deriva en aguas finlandesas tras ser alcanzado y prenderse fuego. La tripulación ha sido evacuada a un buque de carga cercano, según informó la guardia fronteriza del país nórdico. Varias unidades finlandesas y un buque estonio están combatiendo el incendio. El buque de rescate ruso “Murman” también participa en las operaciones de rescate a petición de la guardia fronteriza finlandesa. Finlandia ha indicado que el plan consiste en permitir el remolque del buque averiado hasta aguas rusas. Rusia no ha facilitado más detalles y Ucrania no ha hecho comentarios al respecto. El buque estaba vinculado al ejército ruso y podría haber transportado material militar, según informó el diario “Helsingin Sanomat”, citando a la guardia fronteriza finlandesa. La carga no ha sido verificada, según declaró la guardia fronteriza al periódico con sede en Helsinki. Se trata del segundo buque alcanzado por un dron este mes en el golfo de Finlandia, a medida que las operaciones militares de Ucrania se han extendido a una nueva zona alejada de su frontera con Rusia. La corbeta “Naro-Fominsk”, de la clase “Buyan-M” de la Armada rusa, fue alcanzada el 11 de noviembre como parte de un bombardeo contra Ust-Luga, un importante centro de exportación del Báltico. Por otra parte, Finlandia afirmó que se sospecha que un helicóptero ruso violó su espacio aéreo el sábado por la tarde en las afueras de la localidad de Loviisa, en el golfo de Finlandia. “Los sucesos relacionados con el buque Sparta II en el golfo de Finlandia son graves”, declaró el presidente finlandés, Alexander Stubb, en una publicación en X. El mar Báltico, de aguas poco profundas y rocosas, es una de las vías navegables más transitadas del mundo, por la que transita cada año alrededor del 15% del transporte marítimo de mercancías mundial. Más de tres millones de personas cruzan el golfo de Finlandia en transbordadores de pasajeros cada año, y por él también transitan buques de carga y petroleros, incluida la “flota en la sombra” que transporta petróleo ruso sujeto a sanciones. La región, donde se encuentran varios de los puertos bálticos más grandes de Rusia, también fue objeto de un gran ataque con drones, en el que se derribaron 80 drones ucranianos, según el gobernador. Los ataques con drones del 11 de noviembre en Ust-Luga también causaron daños en la terminal de productos petrolíferos de Novatek PJSC, incluidos los tanques de almacenamiento, así como en la infraestructura de la terminal de productos petrolíferos de Ust-Luga, según informó en su momento el Servicio de Seguridad de Ucrania. Ust-Luga se encuentra a más de 1.000 km al norte de Kiev. Los puertos del Báltico son vitales para las exportaciones rusas de crudo y productos petrolíferos. Su papel en el comercio de combustibles también ha cobrado importancia tras el acuerdo alcanzado en octubre entre el presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, y el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, que permitió a Rusia reanudar parcialmente las exportaciones de gasóleo. Un primer buque cisterna cargado de gasóleo zarpó del puerto báltico de Primorsk en octubre, lo que supuso la reanudación de los envíos marítimos tras el levantamiento parcial de la prohibición de exportación por parte de Moscú. Las rutas del mar Báltico también han cobrado cada vez más importancia para los envíos de cereales, ya que los ataques interrumpen el transporte marítimo tanto desde el sur de Rusia como desde Ucrania. Los puertos del Báltico gestionaron el 65,3% de las exportaciones marítimas de cereales de Rusia en octubre, con un aumento de los envíos de 8,7 veces respecto al año anterior, mientras que los volúmenes de los puertos del mar de Azov y del mar Negro se desplomaron, según la Unión Rusa de Cereales. Ust-Luga fue el mayor puerto exportador de cereales del país durante ese mes, con un volumen de 684.000 toneladas. Por otra parte, el sábado, las autoridades ucranianas afirmaron que las fuerzas rusas lanzaron durante la noche tres misiles balísticos y 148 drones contra diversos objetivos, de los cuales 117 fueron derribados. El presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, declaró el X que se están llevando a cabo esfuerzos para hacer frente a las consecuencias de un ataque ruso perpetrado a última hora del viernes contra Kyrvyi Rih, su ciudad natal, que se saldó con dos fallecidos, entre ellos un niño pequeño, y al menos 60 heridos. --Con la colaboración de Kati Pohjanpalo.

items.title: Russian cargo ship hit by drones in Baltic, Finland tightens security
items.author: CNA
items.summary: “The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas,” Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo says after a drone strike hits the Russian cargo ship Sparta II.
items.body:

Russian cargo ship hit by drones in Baltic, Finland tightens security

“The war is spilling over into our neighbouring areas,” Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo says after a drone strike hits the Russian cargo ship Sparta II.

The damaged Russian cargo ship Sparta II, in a location given as the Gulf of Finland, November 21, 2026. FINNISH BORDER GUARD/Handout via REUTERS

FAST

HELSINKI: A Russian cargo ship caught fire after being hit by drones in the Baltic Sea on Saturday ( Nov 21) and later drifted into Finnish waters, prompting Helsinki to impose temporary air and maritime restrictions and say Ukraine was probably behind the attack.
The Sparta II, bound for Russian exclave Kaliningrad , was damaged in international waters west of Russia's Gogland island, Finland 's Defence Forces said, corroborating an earlier account by Russian officials.
"It is likely that Ukraine...is behind (the attack)," Finnish armed forces spokesperson Aki-Mauri Huhtinen told a press conference, adding it was not clear why the vessel had been targeted.
Finland 's Border Guard said there was no danger to maritime traffic or people, that rescue units were at the scene, and that it was coordinating operations with neighbouring countries.
